name: Movsar Evloev
summary: Undefeated (20-0, 10-0 UFC) featherweight wrestler who has won every UFC fight on the scorecards, most recently a five-round decision over Lerone Murphy in London. Wins by mixing just enough striking to set up chain wrestling and by banking close rounds; gets his first title shot.

how_they_fight.Striking: Functional, not polished: jab, one-two, the odd inside low kick and spinning attacks that per MMA Sucka are often thrown without setup. About 4.6 significant strikes a minute at 52%. Used strikes mainly to cover entries; against Murphy he finished round 3 strongly with an overhand right and a flurry (Reuters via Al Jazeera). Says he has more power this camp (Sherdog).
how_they_fight.Grappling: The base. About 4.5 takedowns per 15 minutes at 55%. Single-leg into inside trip, bodylock slams and back takes, ankle pick paired with an overhand, and re-shoots straight after failed shots (MMA Sucka). Ground-and-pound is light and he rarely threatens submissions in the UFC; Murphy kept getting up in round 5.
how_they_fight.Defense: Never stopped and never seriously hurt in the UFC; 63% strike defence and about 66% takedown defence. Out-struck at range by Murphy in rounds 1-2 before turning the fight with wrestling.
how_they_fight.Pace & cardio: Slow burner who wins late. All 10 UFC wins are decisions; his last finish was in 2018 (Rafael Dias, KO R5, M-1). Career finishes (verified): R1 x2, R2 x3, R3 x1, R5 x1, so 7 of 20 wins inside the distance and none in 7+ years. Against Murphy he lost the early rounds, took R3, and took over R4-R5 with takedowns (late_win_rate 0.81). Has gone five rounds twice (Vitruk 2017, Murphy 2026) plus the R5 KO of Dias. Never been stopped.
how_they_fight.Fight IQ: Disciplined round-banker who wants five rounds ('more time to spend in the cage', UFC.com). Fouls under pressure: a groin kick cost him a point in round 4 against Murphy.

patterns: Starts slowly on the feet, then grows into the fight as wrestling accumulates
Chain wrestling: shot -> combination -> re-shot; bodylock to back
Wins close decisions: Lentz (S-DEC) and Murphy (verified S-DEC; Reuters/UFC.com report a majority decision 48-46, 48-46, 47-47)
No finish since 2018; wins ride on scorecards
concerns: Striking is exploitable at range; Murphy out-landed him early
Little ground-and-pound or submission threat, so opponents get up and reset
Point deduction for a low blow vs Murphy
Long layoffs and many cancelled bouts (UFC.com notes visa trouble before London and that most of his UFC bookings changed); 15 months out before Murphy
keys_to_beat: Win the early rounds at range with jab and movement before his wrestling builds
Get up immediately; his top game is control without much damage
Make him strike first and counter as he rushes entries or throws unset-up spinning attacks

news.text: Made weight at the official weigh-ins: 145 lb (Volkanovski 144.5). Featherweight title fight confirmed.

Sherdog preview: pick'em at -110 each; Sherdog picks Volkanovski by decision but warns Evloev's lack of UFC finishes is no guarantee of safety; notes he can be overly patient and short on striking variety when the takedowns aren't landing.
Says this camp was harder than any before ('I pushed more than ever') and that Volkanovski 'hasn't beaten anyone like me'.
Media day: called it the moment he had waited seven years for; rejected the age angle ('he's old enough to be in his prime'); conceded Jose Aldo's point that he doesn't sell fights.
His coach says they have drilled the kimura, arm-triangle and an undisclosed choke, and expects more kimura attempts than usual (MMA Sucka).
UFC.com Fight By Fight Preview: struck for two rounds against Murphy then landed 9 of 10 takedowns over the final three; still no finish in 10 UFC starts.
Now says he wants to win over five rounds rather than chase a finish, to prove Volkanovski can be beaten over 25 minutes (MMA Sucka): reverses his September talk of a first UFC finish.
Says he is entering his prime and has had his best camp, with more power and conditioning.
Claims Volkanovski was distracted by helping Mauricio Ruffy's camp.
A slight favourite: -115 to Volkanovski's -105 on FanDuel, per BJPenn.com.
Targets his first UFC finish in his first title fight.
Before London: visa problems delayed his arrival and he cut weight while fasting for Ramadan (UFC.com).
